notes.title: First Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42039887/2f7a94f0c861d9b4292d09bbf19de7ffb8d2d5a7.png[/img]
[h1]Crumbling gets its first update v1.0.12[/h1]

A few weeks after releasing the Crumblings into the wild, we have made a few changes and fixes with this update. Most importantly, this update comes with thumbstick locomotion and some quality-of-life improvements.

[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]Thumbstick locomotion. You can configure step-wise and continuous in the menu.
[*]Skip mini games.
[*]Stars for your performance when beating a boss.
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Spiky balls now have way cooler movement. You can swing them at your foes by moving around.
[*]'Missing Page' text in comics is now localized.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]The spiky ball doesn't deal infinite damage anymore when it has the burn-upgrade (whoopsie).
[*]Fixed some toys in the store that couldn't be grabbed.
[*]Narrator slider shows correct volume.
[*]Controller vibration targets whatever hand you are wielding the Crumbling with.
[*]Hands disappear when closing the in-game menu using the menu button.
[*]Scale setting is now saved.
[*]Confident & Berserk collectible aura sound stops again and isn't as loud.
[*]Shaman projectile totems aim at the Golem heart.
[*]No comic page popping up after defeating a boss a second time.
[/list]
[h2]What's next?![/h2]
We are currently working on multiple things in parallel. More Crumblings and theme worlds are in the making. So stay tuned!

notes.title: New trailer, release window and more
notes.notes:
Howdy fellow Crumbling,

It’s been a while! Hope you had a good start in the year!

We have been busy at work finishing Crumbling and just wanted to give you an update on what we are working on!

State of the game and release window

Mostly importantly, we have been working hard to finish the game! :D Development is going very well and Crumbling feels more and more like a full game. We’ve got quite some levels and loads of monsters in good shape but still have a while to go and, of course, still need to polish it. 

But with the current timelines in mind, we should be releasing Crumbling this year. We are crossing our fingers for a summer release for Steam and Quest 2. :) As soon as we know more about a firm date, we will let you know!

[b]New trailer![/b]

[previewyoutube=kDldjRKaATc;full][/previewyoutube]

We have also updated our current trailer since it has been out for a while! If you’ve followed Crumbling for some time, you will be able to spot the new shots. As we get closer to finishing and releasing the game, we also want to share behind-the-scenes looks at Crumbling in the coming weeks more regularly! :) 

Anyway, for now, here is the updated trailer.

That’s it for this week! :) Hope you liked our update. We will be back with more Crumbling news very soon!

Ole
